# Calculate apoptosis flux aross time
## Subset data for analysis
Idents(all_merged_harmony_cluster_v2_PrepSCT_12sample_old_res0.5) <- "Trans_MD_cell"
Epi <- subset(all_merged_harmony_cluster_v2_PrepSCT_12sample_old_res0.5, idents = c("MD", "Non_MD"))
Epi <- subset(Epi, subset = groups != "PPD28")
# Calculate Average Expression for Gene Sets 
Epi <- AddModuleScore(Epi, features = list(pro_apoptosis_genes), name = "ProApoptosisScore")
#Create a box plot comparing the module score for apoptosis across time
# Extract the metadata from your Seurat object (Epi)
metadata <- Epi@meta.data
# Ensure the time points are ordered correctly.
metadata$groups <- factor(metadata$groups, levels = c("E18.5", "PPD1", "PPD2", "PPD3", "PPD4"))
# Create the boxplot with an overlay of the mean trend line
ggplot(metadata, aes(x = groups, y = ProApoptosisScore1, fill = Trans_MD_cell)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line",
               aes(group = Trans_MD_cell, color = Trans_MD_cell),
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), size = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point",
               aes(group = Trans_MD_cell, color = Trans_MD_cell),
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("MD" = "#bf0a30", "Non_MD" = "#0041c2")) +
  labs(title = "Apoptosis Module Score by Cell Type and Time",
       x = "Time Point",
       y = "Module Score (ProApoptosisScore1)",
       fill = "Cell Type",
       color = "Cell Type") +
  theme_classic()
# Calculate p-values for each time point
stat_results <- metadata %>%
  group_by(groups) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(p_value = wilcox.test(ProApoptosisScore1 ~ Trans_MD_cell)$p.value)
